title: ViewFlex
description: FreeCam and FreeLook combined into one lightweight client-side mod.
body:
# FreeCam+FreeLook
# 
A lightweight client-side mod that combines FreeCam and FreeLook into one seamless experience.

Features
FreeCam mode for exploring without moving your player
FreeLook mode for looking around independently
Smooth camera movement
Customizable keybinds
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Fabric 1.21.11 support
Usage

Configure keybinds in the Minecraft Controls menu and toggle FreeCam or FreeLook anytime.

Compatibility
Minecraft 1.21.11
Fabric Loader
Client-side only

Perfect for PvP, building, exploration, screenshots, and content creation. 🚀

Keywords: freecam, freelook, camera mod, pvp, screenshots, exploration, fabric, minecraft 1.21.11.
